name: Inverse Finance YVCrv3CryptoFeed spot-balance LP valuation
summary: YVCrv3CryptoFeed priced Anchor's yvCurve-3Crypto collateral from tricrypto2's live token balances times Chainlink prices over LP supply. With flash-loaned WBTC the attacker minted the collateral, then swapped heavily through tricrypto2 to inflate the balance-sum price about 2.9x and borrowed DOLA against it, leaving the collateral behind.
notes: The feed has no setters, but the exploit also needed Anchor's Oracle to point anYvCrv3Crypto at it; that pointer was set with the market listing and 70% collateral factor in one governance tx, the reset (rule 10). The later raise to 80% only sized the loss.

Loss is the full DOLA borrow; the yvCurve-3Crypto collateral left behind is not netted (rule 14). Inverse's reported net loss and the attacker's ~1.26M profit are other measures. Only one anYvCrv3Crypto Mint ever happened, so there is no campaign.
Separate incident from the April 2022 xINV InvFeed exploit: a different feed contract and defect.
